title: The Old Light F6 - The One Joke
_note: Old Light floor 6 (pearlmoor_oldlight_6), the emotional heart: Tam's joke written for someone who never came home. The theme collapsed to a slow, detuned music-box in F harmonic minor (A->Ab, D->Db): a bell lead an octave up, a second quieter bell a sixteenth behind it that SAGS a semitone on every held note (the detune), a lower comb picking slow broken chords, a faint string bed. No laughs - where they were, the box just holds; once (bar 8) a ghost of the "ha-ha" falls, soft. The mechanism ticks each beat and falters in the last two bars as the spring runs down, stopping on the dominant (G over C7) - the unfinished punchline - which leans back into bar 1. 66 BPM, 4/4, F minor, 16 bars.
